data.name: Harvard Square Evening Excursion through Cambridge
data.headline: 2 Hours • Ages 5+
data.description:
#Here's your chance to make Cambridge yours, too!! We'll take you on America's first subway from Boston Common to the hustle and bustle of Harvard Square in Cambridge on the other side of the Charles River. 

##Duration:

- 2 hours

##Your 2-hour Harvard Square Excursion Highlights include:

- Harvard Yard and Radcliff Yard
- Brattle Street ("Tory Row")
- The "Old Burial Place"
- Longfellow's Mansion
- "The Square" itself - street entertainers, chess games, the “buzz”

##About
Spend an evening at Harvard Square. Your experienced guide will escort you on the Red Line Subway to the hustle and bustle of Harvard Square, Cambridge, where we’ll listen to the street musicians and watch the chess matches in action. We’ll tour Harvard Yard, which takes on an eerily spooky feel in the evening, and check out Cambridge’s Old Burial Ground colonial cemetery. 

You will have the option of returning to Park Street with your guide or staying on in Harvard Square for dinner (perhaps The Border Café or John Harvard’s Brew House), or going into one of Harvard Square’s many entertainment spots (like Club Passim). 


**What Is Not Included?**

Though no food and drinks are provided on this tour, your subway fare will be included in the cost of your ticket!

 
**Meeting Location**

Near Park and Tremont Streets on Bostom Common (Boston, MA) 
(Exact meeting location details will be provided immediately upon purchase of tickets.)

data.booking_notes:
**Important Notice:** Please arrive at least 10 minutes before your scheduled tour time, as tours depart right on time.

**Meeting Location:** The tour will begin outside the Park Street "T" Station on Boston Common, at the corner of Park and Tremont Streets. Look for your Boston CityWalks Tour Guide with either a dark shirt or jacket with the "Boston CityWalks" name and a dark blue "Boston CityWalks" cap. Please call 508.904.2819 for last minute help if you cannot locate the starting point or if you will be late.

**What to Wear**

You will be outside for much of the tour, so dress for the forecasted weather! We recommend layers, as the temperatures can become higher throughout the day. (It's easy to peel a layer off!)
Wear comfortable walking shoes.
On sunny days, we suggest you use sunscreen. Hats and sunglasses can also be helpful.
If the weather forecast calls for rain or showers, rain jackets, umbrellas and hats can help. On most tours, the guide will have emergency ponchos available in case of unexpected inclement weather.
 
**What to Bring/What Not to Bring**

We suggest you bring a bottle of water with you. These can also be purchased at street vendors along the way. (If you intend to purchase water, be sure to bring some extra cash!)
If you have young children, it is highly recommended that you bring a folding carriage with you, as kids do get tired along the way.
And of course, BRING YOUR CAMERA!!
 
**Other Tips & Guidelines**

Please arrive at least 10 minutes before scheduled departure time.
If there are any particular types of things you would like to see or hear about, please get ready to let your guide know.
If you have any problems or questions prior to the tour, you can call our main number at 866-WE-WALKS. If you need to reach us close to tour time, call 508-904-2819.
Gratuities are not required, but certainly are welcome and appreciated!!
